link.note: Witness in 1815 and 1836 Munzingen entries; relationship speculative.

summary: A glazier turned farmer who witnessed Heitzler family events in 1815 and 1836; probably an uncle or grandfather of Agatha Heizler.
bio: Johann Federer was a glazier who later turned to farming. He appears as a witness at the burial of Veronica Heitzler in 1815 and again at the marriage of a Birkenmayer to a Heizler in 1836, when the register described him as "formerly glazier, now farmer". He was probably a relative of Agatha Heizler, perhaps her uncle or her grandfather. It is possible, though no more than a guess, that Servatius learned the glazier's trade from him.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1590 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, civil-register duplicates/Standesbücher 1810–1839; 549 images; record id 5-480946) http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-119 ; http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-464
